typedChecks.sourceText: Adult participants (age ≥ 18 years old) with any of the following advanced or metastatic solid tumors (documented history of histologically confirmed diagnosis):
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Adult participants (age ≥ 18 years old) with any of the following advanced or metastatic solid tumors (documented history of histologically confirmed diagnosis):

typedChecks.sourceText: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥1500/mm3 (≥1.5 x 109/L)
Hemoglobin (Hb) ≥9.0 g/dL

Adequate renal function defined by creatinine clearance (CLCR) ≥ 60 mL/min calculated as follows: CLCR = eGFR in ml/min/1.73 m2 calculated by the Modified Diet in Renal Disease (MDRD) x participant body surface area (BSA) in m2 ÷ 1.73

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: All participants must have progressed on at least 2 prior systemic therapies, except for recurrent GB
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior-lines rule has exceptions for recurrent glioblastoma and cannot be represented as a single unconditional typed prior_lines_min check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of at least 1 measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by the Investigator (not applicable for GBM). At least 1 identified measurable lesion must show GRPR uptake in 203Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 SPECT/CT (uptake greater than that of the background) as assessed by the Investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST and nuclear medicine tracer uptake are subjective imaging assessments and not typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Capable of giving signed informed consent
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Informed consent capability is a subjective clinical evaluation, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: All participants must have progressed on at least 2 prior systemic therapies, except for recurrent GB
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior lines requirement has exceptions for specific cancer types, preventing a simple universal prior_lines_min check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For participants with mCRPC: Prior orchiectomy and/or ongoing androgen deprivation therapy and a castrate level of serum testosterone (<50 ng/dL or <1.7 nmol/L)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Subpopulation-specific rule with multiple hormonal and surgical alternatives.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of at least 1 measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by the Investigator (not applicable for GBM). At least 1 identified measurable lesion must show GRPR uptake in 203Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 SPECT/CT (uptake greater than that of the background) as assessed by the Investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: RECIST measurable disease and nuclear medicine uptake criteria are subjective imaging assessments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For participants with prostate cancer that do not have measurable soft tissue disease, 203Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 uptake in bone lesions > uptake in background is acceptable for eligibility.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Alternative imaging uptake criteria for prostate cancer are subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: For women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) and men with partners of childbearing potential: be willing to use highly effective methods of contraception or sexual abstinence, if part of participant's lifestyle, throughout the study and for 7 months for WOCBP, 4 months for men after the last [212Pb]Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 administration or for 10 days following [203Pb]Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 administration and participant is not proceeding to 212Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 treatment, as outlined in protocol.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contraception compliance and willingness to abstain are behavioral requirements.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Having first or second glioblastoma recurrence, after standard therapy that includes prior radiation therapy (RT) and at least 12 weeks from completion of RT prior to first administration of 212Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1. In case surgery has been performed for GBM recurrence, the surgery has to be completed at least 4 weeks prior to 212Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 treatment start, with post-surgery recovery without any complications related to surgical procedure.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex disease-specific prior therapy timing and surgical recovery requirements for GBM.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) status 0-1. Participants with ECOG status of 2 may be approved on a case-by-case basis in discussion with the Sponsor.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: deterministic normalizer did not verify this model check

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≤3x upper limit of normal (ULN) or ≤ 5 x ULN in the presence of liver metastases
